_comment: The Barbarian's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json, the Warrior's layout):
a class tree and its three specializations, Brutalité, Chasseur de têtes and Ascendance. Active nodes
and choices marked existing name abilities authored in localTools/barbarian/Spells.ps1; the other ranks are
generated by localTools/talentTree/TalentRankSpells.ps1, real auras where they declare one and otherwise dummies
modules/mod-barbarian reads. Class mask words: word 0 one bit per ability (Spells.ps1), word 2 bit 1 every
Barbarian ability. Rank ids 97300-97599; word 1 the Chasseur de têtes and Ascendance abilities.
